{{Quote|Me and my crew just keep things running. Lights, water, atmosphere.|[[Junker Jott]], to the [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="TOR:TGoMS" />}}
'''Junker Jott's crew''' was a group of journeymen, [[Technician/Legends|technicians]], [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] and [[Cleaning droid/Legends|utility droids]] based on [[Mek-Sha]].<ref name="TOR:JJC" /> Led by [[Junker Jott]], it was one of the five ruling organizations on Mek-Sha by [[3627 BBY]]. Though not as powerful as other groups on the station's ruling council, they were allowed a seat because they kept the station's basic functions running.<ref name="TOR:TGoMS" />
